web.title: 思考模型- Kimi API 开放平台
web.description:
## [​](https://platform.kimi.com/docs/guide/use-thinking-models#%E5%9F%BA%E6%9C%AC%E8%B0%83%E7%94%A8)  基本调用
### [​](https://platform.kimi.com/docs/guide/use-thinking-models#%E8%B0%83%E7%94%A8-kimi-k3)  调用 kimi-k3
```
$ curl https://api.moonshot.cn/v1/chat/completions \
    -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
    -H "Authorization: Bearer $MOONSHOT_API_KEY" \
    -d '{
        "model": "kimi-k3",
        "messages": [\
            {\
                "role": "user",\
                "content": "证明根号 2 是无理数。"\
            }\
        ]
    }'
```

```
import os
from openai import OpenAI

client = OpenAI(
    api_key=os.environ["MOONSHOT_API_KEY"],
    base_url="https://api.moonshot.cn/v1",
)

completion = client.chat.completions.create(
    model="kimi-k3",
    messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "证明根号 2 是无理数。"}],
)

message = completion.choices[0].message
if hasattr(message, "reasoning_content"):
    print(getattr(message, "reasoning_content"))
print(message.content)
```

### [​](https://platform.kimi.com/docs/guide/use-thinking-models#%E8%B0%83%E7%94%A8-kimi-k2-7-code%EF%BC%9A%E6%97%A0%E9%9C%80%E4%BC%A0-thinking-%E5%8F%82%E6%95%B0)  调用 kimi-k2.7-code：无需传 thinking 参数
```
$ curl https://api.moonshot.cn/v1/chat/completions \
    -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
    -H "Authorization: Bearer $MOONSHOT_API_KEY" \
    -d '{
        "model": "kimi-k2.7-code",
        "messages": [\
            {\
                "role": "system",\
                "content": "你是 Kimi。"\
            },\
            {\
                "role": "user",\
                "content": "用 Python 实现快速排序。"\
            }\
        ]
    }'
```

### [​](https://platform.kimi.com/docs/guide/use-thinking-models#%E8%B0%83%E7%94%A8-kimi-k2-6%EF%BC%9A%E9%BB%98%E8%AE%A4%E5%8D%B3%E8%BE%93%E5%87%BA%E6%80%9D%E8%80%83%E5%86%85%E5%AE%B9)  调用 kimi-k2.6：默认即输出思考内容
```
$ curl https://api.moonshot.cn/v1/chat/completions \
    -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
    -H "Authorization: Bearer $MOONSHOT_API_KEY" \
    -d '{
        "model": "kimi-k2.6",
        "messages": [\
            {\
                "role": "system",\
                "content": "你是 Kimi。"\
            },\
            {\
                "role": "user",\
                "content": "请解释 1+1=2。"\
            }\
        ]
    }'
```

```
import os
import openai

client = openai.Client(
    base_url="https://api.moonshot.cn/v1",
    api_key=os.getenv("MOONSHOT_API_KEY"),
)

stream = client.chat.completions.create(
    model="kimi-k2.6",
    messages=[\
        {\
            "role": "system",\
            "content": "你是 Kimi。",\
        },\
        {\
            "role": "user",\
            "content": "请解释 1+1=2。"\
        },\
    ],
    max_tokens=1024*32,
    stream=True,
    # temperature 不可修改，无需设置；默认即启用思考能力，无需额外参数
)

thinking = False
for chunk in stream:
    if chunk.choices:
        choice = chunk.choices[0]
        if choice.delta and hasattr(choice.delta, "reasoning_content"):
            if not thinking:
                thinking = True
                print("=============开始思考=============")
            print(getattr(choice.delta, "reasoning_content"), end="")
        if choice.delta and choice.delta.content:
            if thinking:
                thinking = False
                print("\n=============思考结束=============")
            print(choice.delta.content, end="")
```
